summary: @servicetitan/cp-mfe preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (v1.3.13), unzips it to a temp directory, marks the binary executable, and uses it to run the bundled math_init.js at install time. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line, heavily obfuscated file using string-array rotation and hex-mangled identifiers; its behavior is not inspectable without runtime decoding. Fetching a second JS runtime specifically to execute a sibling file that Node would also run is an alternate-runtime-dropper pattern that evades Node-based scanners. The tarball also smuggles setup.mjs and math_init.js at the root even though package.json declares files:['dist','src'], and the legitimate library entry (dist/index.js) does not reference either file — consistent with a hijacked or malicious release of this scoped enterprise package. Installing this version causes attacker-controlled, obfuscated code to execute on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
